intro: Generates a starting map for a programmable ECU: fuel, ignition, VE, lambda and correction curves, ready to import into your software.
deadtime_hint: Dead time at 14 V (injector data sheet)
offset_hint: Shifts the whole timing map (+ = more advance)

r.required_note: For 80% duty at the highest load point
r.idle_note: Excluding dead time; below 0.8 ms metering becomes inaccurate

warn.start_map: Conservative STARTING map, not a final tune: tune on a dyno with a wideband lambda sensor and knock detection, starting at light load.
warn.duty_high: Injectors too small: above 85% duty at the highest load point. Fit larger injectors or raise fuel pressure.
warn.duty_limit: Injectors at the limit (80–85%): no reserve for cold days or more boost.
warn.injector_big: Very large injectors for this engine: idle and light load will be hard to tune (very short pulse widths).
warn.lambda_order: Full-load mixture must be richer (lower lambda) than cruise.
warn.lambda_boost: Lambda too lean for a boosted engine: aim for 0.76–0.82 under boost.
warn.import: In {s}: import each CSV file into the matching table and check that the axes (rpm, kPa) are identical before writing to the ECU.
warn.deadtime: The dead-time curve is an approximation: replace it with the values from your injectors' data sheet.

t.fuel_intro: Dead time included, one injection per cycle (sequential), air at 20 °C
t.ign_intro: Conservative values accounting for octane, compression ratio and boost
t.ve_intro: For ECUs running VE / speed-density mode
t.deadtime_intro: Approximation, replace with the injector data sheet
t.idle_intro: Speed added to the normal idle
t.accel_intro: Temporary extra fuel versus throttle opening rate (%/0.1 s)
t.baro_intro: Alpha-N (throttle) mode only: in speed-density the MAP sensor already corrects
